fields.summary_ko.0: Intel (INTC) CEO Lip-Bu Tan purchased $9.71 million (approximately 1.5 million shares) between $64.71-$64.74 per share, showing confidence.
fields.summary_ko.1: Intel exceeded Q3 revenue expectations at $16.5B but Q4 guidance of $15-16B significantly undershot market expectations of $17.29B, causing after-hours sharp decline.
